sources.note: Netsmart main site. Describes CareFabric platform, lists all products including TheraOffice. Confirms company serves behavioral health, human services, post-acute care, senior living markets.

Lists eight certified products including TheraOffice. Describes TheraOffice as comprehensive PT EMR for physical, occupational, speech and behavioral therapies. Links to certification letters and EHI export documentation.

Main TheraOffice product page (redirects from theraoffice.com). Details four core modules: documentation (40+ templates), scheduling (mobile check-in, optimizer), billing (ERA, denial tracking, claims), reporting (175+ reports). Lists AI documentation, telehealth, patient portal, MIPS registry, e-faxing features.
TheraOffice specialty practices page. Same feature details as main product page. Confirms PT, OT, SLP specialties plus McKenzie, lymphedema, pelvic health, pediatric, vestibular.

July 2024 press release on ONC certification. Describes TheraOffice as integrated PT/rehab EMR with patient intake, documentation, scheduling, billing, accounting, clinical reporting. Notes MIPS Promoting Interoperability requirement for therapy providers starting 2024.

April 2022 acquisition announcement. TheraOffice founded 2001 by Dan Morrill (PT) and Ryan Havlick (developer). Served 'thousands of clinical practices.' Expanded Netsmart CareFabric into outpatient rehabilitation.
Business Wire version of ONC certification announcement. Mentions secure exchange of patient health data and electronic referrals, MIPS quality measure support, HIPAA-compliant patient access.

FindEMR profile. Lists features: clinical documentation, practice management, outcome tracking, patient engagement, reporting. Mentions QuickBooks and Google Calendar integrations. Notes 70% negative feedback on accounting module complexity.

2025 Black Book Research Survey results. TheraOffice ranked #1 EMR/PM for PT and outpatient rehab. 902 practices evaluated 58 solutions. Recognized for RCM, telehealth, population health, HIE capabilities.
Kroll M&A advisory page confirming TheraOffice sale to Netsmart completed April 21, 2022.
Genstar Capital sale of Netsmart to GI Partners/Allscripts JV in 2016. Provides Netsmart corporate ownership history.
GI Partners and TA Associates buyout of Allscripts stake in Netsmart (2018). Confirms current ownership structure.
Netsmart company profile estimating ~$546M revenue, ~2,500 employees.
TheraOffice patient portal login page. Confirms patient portal exists as a web-based application.
